courses.title: Iyengar Yoga and Aging Workshop IN STUDIO
courses.description: A two-hour Saturday morning workshop for all levels at the centre's Fort Street studio, taught by Claudia MacDonald. It looks at Iyengar yoga practice as we grow older.

flags: Only the title frames it around ageing (the calendar entry calls it 'Yoga and Healthy Aging Workshop'); neither page makes any health claim, so it passes the 12 Nov rule.

Both the workshop page and its calendar entry (https://iyengaryogacentre.ca/event/yoga-and-healthy-aging-workshop-in-studio-45/2026-12-05/) are thin: date, time (10:30 to 12:30), $45 and the teacher's name only, so the description stays short.
